problem_statement: When the mDNS responder answers a unicast query (the QU bit set) for a record type it does not host, the response omits the NSEC record that proves the record's non-existence, even though a comparable multicast response includes it. As a result a client cannot confirm that the queried record is absent. The responder must include the NSEC record in the additional section of unicast responses, matching the behavior it already has for multicast responses.
